remarks: Experience luxury living in this exquisitely renovated 2 BR, 2 BA condo at Mill River House. The updated kitchen boasts stunning new quartz countertops, while the two bathrooms have been elegantly redesigned. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry, a freshly painted interior, and a cozy mantle with a fireplace that adds modern sophistication. Both spacious bedrooms feature walk-in closets, and the private deck offers direct exterior access. The unit includes a smart-enabled thermostat and security system for added comfort and peace of mind. Residents can take advantage of the on-site fitness center and shared club room. With two dedicated parking garage spaces, this condo is ideally situated near shops, fine dining, I-95, and the train station. Professional photos to be uploaded shortly.
